capabilities: Grade notes with Again/Hard/Good/Easy using the SM-2 algorithm
Color file explorer notes green/yellow/orange/red by overdue status
Tint folders by the share of fresh notes they contain
Color graph view nodes via a review_status property and color groups
Seed existing notes from their file dates and show scheduled intervals on grading buttons
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; manual installation via copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css is also documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule note reviews or see at a glance which notes are overdue for review.
summary: Spaced-repetition plugin that grades notes with the SM-2 algorithm and color-codes the file explorer, folders and graph view by how overdue each note is.
